checks.evidence: Test 'Overlap timer start upon passing start location' step 2 only checks that the timer starts when the max safe front end passes the start location. It does not check that the timer runs for the time-out, that the overlap is withdrawn afterwards, or that the supervised location and release speed change to the Danger Point values.

invented: The OBU provides a diagnostic interface to observe the state of the Overlap timer (stated as an assumption, so not counted as invented)
